statement_short: Resummed bubble chain: W = Z3 + g^2 int rho/(s+Q^2); contact-free H3 holds for Z3 > 0, fails for Z3 < 0 (spacelike pole) and fails at Z3 = 0 when the total mass is finite (constant 1/mu; with infinite mass it holds); one positive atom above a hard cutoff for Z3 > 0.
assumptions: rho_J >= 0 not identically zero; finite inverse moment; g_R^2 > 0; once-subtracted Dyson form; for the atom, a hard cutoff with rho_J nonzero at the edge
proof_location: paper/appendix.tex, 'The resummed bubble chain'; notes/H3_RPA_proof_note_2026-09-29.md, Props 1-6
external_theorem_used: Stieltjes / complete Bernstein duality (f Stieltjes iff z f(z) complete Bernstein iff 1/f complete Bernstein)
citation: Schilling-Song-Vondracek 2012, 2nd ed.; theorem number PENDING_VERIFICATION (secondary sources cite Thm 7.3 or Cor 7.4); Giacosa-Wolkanowski 2012 for the atom mechanism
numerical_test: tests/test_h3_rpa_obstruction.py (regimes, residue sign, sum rules, dropped-atom detection, exact uniform anchor); tests/test_rpa_closed_form_and_contracts.py; tests/test_rpa_reference_precision.py (multiprecision)
unresolved_issue: Covers only the bubble chain with the one-loop matter density. Irreducible O(g^6) terms and the nonperturbative Wilson-loop kernel are not addressed. The fate of the atom under a smooth regulator (resonance on another sheet) is not shown.
